subject: a mod loading error message fixed with Makefile library changing

messages.author: 2d88bb383d6d6aa9
messages.subject: a mod loading error message fixed with Makefile library changing
parts:
Some enviromment of *NIX platform , when httpd starting load
mod_R.so , prompt the error message is :

httpd: Syntax error on line 54 of /etc/apache2/httpd.conf: Cannot
load /etc/apache2/modules/mod_R.so into server: /usr/lib/
libreadline.so.6: undefined symbol: tgetstr

this can be fixed with append -lcurses in rapache Makefile.
